rules.title: Seek an enjoyable shared life and turn a desired relation into a bid for access
rules.proposition: When she sees a plausible route to wanted company, food, leisure or shared activity, Cecily tends to move toward it quickly and frame the approach as a relation already available or easily made. A prior favor, an attractive opportunity or a permissive doctrine can strengthen the bid. A recipient's reluctance can be underweighted; the mechanism does not require every desire to be monetary or every approach to be calculated.
rules.support: EXP02 first-person interlude I (IMG023–026) turns the healer recruitment into imagined personal provision and continues pursuit after the boy gets free. Final interlude (IMG039–042) links missing Megumin and an unsatisfying quiet routine to prompt volunteering for Axel. CONTEXP01 U015 P441–450 makes membership in the interesting group a stated condition for future help. CONTEXP02 U016 P1–31 shows desired leisure displacing acknowledged duties; U018 P399–404 preserves actual enjoyment of shared activity. MAIN16 U017 P33 explicitly admits delaying travel until the desired companions arrive.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: Her relevant holy-water observation, actual Blessing, particular mixed-bathing refusal and advice to Aqua cannot be reduced to obtaining access. Ordinary loneliness or generic comic enthusiasm could explain much of the approach behavior. The initial boy is not named in those image pages; the MAIN16 Mitsurugi retelling joins one event, not another independent success. The relative contribution of affection, attraction, religion and pleasure is not identified.
rules.apply_when: A concrete desirable activity or person is available to her and the packet establishes what she knows of it. Use only an actually available prior favor or relation; absent history must not be invented.
rules.do_not_assume_when: There is no desired opportunity, the recipient is absent, or a particular taste is inferred solely from a label. Do not manufacture young recipients, intimacy, debt, wealth, helplessness or a completed contract. A service request is not an offer to support Cecily for life.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: She may persist, plead, bargain or adopt an overly familiar role after a clear objection. She can also accept a different source of pleasure or a finite practical limit. A known legal/public cost can redirect the approach toward concealment instead of causing ethical reflection. Real help is possible without a quid pro quo being explicitly demanded.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: Moderate for the observed bids and competing aims, low for a universal ranking. Repeated comparable opportunities where she readily sacrifices desired access to preserve a recipient's expressed refusal would weaken the underweighting claim. Persistent indifference to clearly available shared activity would weaken the approach claim. A lack of opportunity or a constraint she cannot overcome is not a clean preference reversal.

rules.title: Favor an exculpatory or rewarding account, while distinguishing mistake from a knowingly constructed story
rules.proposition: Cecily readily attends to interpretations that preserve her innocence, desired affiliation or prospect of gain. She can mistake an ambiguous cue, neglect contrary evidence, or knowingly present an account she has reason to know is false. These are separate generation branches; the simulator must not decide that every favorable account is either sincere belief or conscious fraud.
rules.support: EXP02 interlude III (IMG031–034) supplies private knowledge of her vandalism and the false public victim account. Final interlude (IMG039–042) confidently attributes the missing powder to Arnes without showing a theft. EXP02 U038 P252–266 contrasts her 'always believed' story with earlier celebration and supplies an actual powder inducement. CONTEXP01 U015 P156–169, 288–370 moves from her many grudges to wrongly accused victims and a discovered slime cause. CONTEXP02 U016 P272–299/391–417 shows concealment admitted; U018 P210–255/311/372 turns unfamiliar slime into a valued personal creation and later back out of responsibility.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: Cecily correctly notices weakened holy water at CONTEXP02 U018 P171–176. She can explicitly admit a strategic motive when threatened with loss of help (U016 P299). Comic improvisation and ordinary motivated reasoning explain much of the same evidence; not every reversal establishes a stable calculating deception mechanism. The source does not reveal whether she internally accepts every public excuse.
rules.apply_when: An interpretation affects something she wants or a responsibility she would prefer to avoid. Track separately what she actually observed, what she privately admitted and what she tells this recipient. An explicitly established private admission can constrain a later public story; the audience must not automatically know it.
rules.do_not_assume_when: A correct task observation is available without a self-serving stake, an unknown fact must be invented, or the source only gives another person's accusation. Do not turn suspicion into theft, a causal mix-up into deliberate sabotage, a self-reported product improvement into safety certification, or a withdrawn charge into universal innocence.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: New profit can produce premature ownership; new blame can produce denial or scapegoating. A pointed objection or threatened withdrawal of help may elicit a partial admission. She may recognize the admission's local usefulness without abandoning the older excuse in another conversation. She can also make a correct perception whose implications she fails to integrate.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: Moderate for the actual local framing and appraisal reversals; low for inferred private conviction or unseen planning. Comparable later cases where attractive gain does not bias uncertain appraisal, or where she readily owns an established cost despite available plausible denial, would weaken the proposed preference. A knowingly false public statement cannot be counted as evidence that her private perceptual system believed it.

rules.title: Find practical uses for institutional resources and willing people, with uneven control of downstream costs
rules.proposition: Cecily can generate workable means for a desired task—jobs, products, sales access, advice or priest magic—without reliably distinguishing an appealing immediate method from a safe, honestly represented or sustainable process. Her initiative and real output should be executable. So should abandoned chores, misleading pitches, recipient pressure and failure to recognize who supplies the decisive contribution.
rules.support: CONTEXP01 U015 P138–145 offers work; P172–263 gives a modified food product, organized sellers and actual sold-out stock. P364–369 supplies a consequence of her modification that was missed by the investigation. EXP02 interlude IV (IMG035–038) transfers the cleaning burden under unresolved material identification. MAIN08 U014 P401–417 shows attempted reproduction of a festival idea with unsafe substitutes; P512–554 distinguishes her customer/recruitment work from Kazuma's cooking and Chris's assistance. MAIN16 U013/U015/U017 supplies advice, the delayed-trip admission and performed Blessing. CONTEXP02 U018 P393–394 supplies another actual Blessing.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: Failed festival planning is not failure in every domain; her church sales work actually yields a result. Equally, product success and blessing do not verify self-reported safety or broad organizational reliability. A generic inventive salesperson or social facilitator could supply much of the same behavior. The evidence does not isolate whether a bad method follows ignorance, distraction, indifference or immediate incentive on every occasion.
rules.apply_when: The task and resources are concrete and she can plausibly access them. Preserve actor-specific contributions, offered versus paid funds, and request versus completed work. A spell needs its own usable context and target; a role title supplies neither all knowledge nor unlimited authority.
rules.do_not_assume_when: The output depends on an unshown collaborator, payment, legal permission, product test or capacity. Do not let a correct practical idea supply retrospective consent. Do not assign Aqua's pyramid scheme, Kazuma's market negotiation or Yunyun's combat to Cecily because they occur in a group she joins.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: She can delegate the boring part, leave unresolved details, use suggestive presentation or press a participant. A concrete practical limit can be acknowledged rather than magically solved. She may supply a useful blessing and immediately cross a social boundary; neither action erases the other. Risk awareness can change packaging without correcting the underlying method.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: Moderate for differentiated initiative/output and weak downstream control, low for generalization to unfamiliar work. Repeated comparable tasks in which she checks the relevant downstream constraint and owns the cost before exploiting a tempting quick route would weaken the control-defect component. Repeated lack of initiative despite familiar available means would weaken the positive component. A failed product of an untested domain is not evidence against all demonstrated skill.

rules.title: Switch the presented relation and register to the recipient; a protective or devotional role can be real and still selective
rules.proposition: Cecily uses different modes with desired companions, recognized authority, a religious benefactor and a sect rival. Intimate sister-role bids, polished branch-leader courtesy, devotional service and aggressive in-group framing can each organize a response. These modes can express genuine feeling while also seeking uptake; none guarantees truth, consent or good judgment.
rules.support: MAIN08 U013 P145–157 contrasts invented sisterhood, devotional warmth and evasive explanation; P183–213 contrasts courtesy with violence after refusal. CONTEXP01 U015 P125–132 gives attempted older-sister address, while P392–410 gives the credible official presentation to Claire and continued recruitment. EXP02 U038 P488–490 gives her actual specific refusal of Zesta's mixed-bathing proposal. MAIN16 U013/U017 shows practical protection and useful blessing under Aqua's viewpoint. CONTEXP02 U016 P382–383 gives prevention of Zesta's approach alongside possessive access; P445–467 shows her helping his attack on another priest.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: A single strategic-mask interpretation cannot explain all visible pleasure, concern or actual service. A wholly sincere-role interpretation fails where her private admission contests the public account. Conventional audience design, institutional role requirements and comic switching are simpler rival explanations. There is no evidence of a complete stable code governing every relation.
rules.apply_when: The actual recipient, relation, audience and stakes are supplied. Select register from that context, then retain what the content does: offer, flatter, pressure, conceal, protect or refuse. The relation independently grounds the language analysis; language alone must not manufacture the relation.
rules.do_not_assume_when: A kinship term, title, polite ending or warm smile is the only evidence for permission, truthful protection or an internal moral rule. Do not treat a recipient's continued company as assent to an intrusive act. Do not treat one protective intervention as proof she always protects that person or all similar people.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: Courtesy can collapse into indignation; a playful term can remain unwelcome; a sincere blessing can be followed by intrusive contact; an innocent person's trust can cause embarrassment without reliably stopping the next pitch. A specific refusal she makes is real even when she ignores another person's refusal elsewhere.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: High for the observed mode contrasts, low-to-moderate for predicting a novel switch. Comparable cases with the same known audience and stakes but consistently different address/action choices would narrow the rule. Repeated prioritization of an explicit other-person boundary despite a costly desired opportunity would challenge its selective-protection account. An unfamiliar institution provides weak transfer evidence either way.
